name: NGC 3510 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3510, an edge-on barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3510-hubble
story: We see NGC 3510 edge-on, and beyond its stars the galaxy's hydrogen gas bends into a warp. Hubble studied the stars in warps like this one to learn whether infalling gas is still feeding galaxy disks.

claims.text: NGC 3510 is UGC 6126, a barred galaxy of type SBcd
The hydrogen (HI) disk of NGC 3510 is warped
Program 13357 studies resolved stars in the warps of nearby edge-on galaxies, including NGC 3510, to test whether cold gas accretion forms warps and fuels disks
